description: This Java class, BlockCreditsToSavingsAccountCommandHandler, handles commands to block credits on a savings account within the Fineract platform. It implements the NewCommandSourceHandler interface and delegates the actual blocking operation to the SavingsAccountWritePlatformService.

classes.name: BlockCreditsToSavingsAccountCommandHandler
classes.description: A service class that processes commands to block credits on a savings account by utilizing SavingsAccountWritePlatformService.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the command by delegating to the writePlatformService's blockCredits method for the specified savings account ID.
